original_card.question: Can one misleading historical-current claim or missing research cross-reference be corrected?
methods: Trace one confusing path from onboarding to its authoritative source.
Index one tightly related family of obstructions with explicit excluded and open hypotheses.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Produce evidence-backed navigation, preserve historical records and avoid a duplicate global survey.

first_step.inspect: Resolve the current selected review, separate complex/ordinary BIT/admitted BIT/outer budgets, and compare the card against live handoffs before starting. Historical ceilings require exact source/model equivalence.
first_step.scope: Source-binding orientation only; not a scientific replay or all-size proof. Materialize selected inputs if this checkout is sparse.

original_card.first_experiment: Repair one confusing path or produce a scoped map of one related obstruction family.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Clear navigation lowers entry cost for central research; a global survey without a concrete fix is not required.
allowed_variations: One historical-current ambiguity or one bounded family index.
scope_change_triggers: Rewriting frozen scientific packages just to change their historical wording.

actual_scope: Map the f(7) records in PR943's prefix-walk model (item 5 of petalas's consolidation handoff): per length step, the routes, independent coverage and open obligations. Extended with a complete second-engine replay of the length-22 census (#4221/#4871 open question 1), using #3005's engine with only its length gate lifted.
scope_change_reason: The map identified the single-engine dependency of the census route as its main open obligation, and the blocker recorded by #4221 (#3005's engine gated at L<=20, throughput unmeasured) turned out to be a two-line constant change. Running it settles that blocker, so the extension stayed inside the same family index.
bottleneck_link: Side result for navigation: f(7) is a finite connector-model value used by #5234, #5430 and #6005, not a κ input. Clear status stops sessions from reopening a settled question, and it names the precise open steps.
stop_rule: Stop at the session budget; report any split not finished as unfinished, not excluded. All eleven finished (the three heaviest in background after the session, 3751-4188 s each).
evidence: verify.py: pinned inputs, 21 quoted scope sentences against their READMEs, the length-24 witness by direct XOR, #4221 receipt closure (7+4=11 splits), lifted-engine controls (L18/L20 exact equality with #3005 FULL.json, n=6 L22 positive control, cap fail-closed), exact replay of completed L22 splits. All eleven L22 splits complete with zero hits on the lifted engine. The full L22 runs are local-only receipts in RESULT.json.
